_why: Units whose vdata has no m_strCustomUnitIcon. The portraits are the ones the game itself shows for these unit classes in its ping wheel (scripts/ping_wheel_messages.vdata, build 6726): 'Push Patron' -> npcs/tier_3_boss, 'Push Shrine' -> npcs/shield_generator, Guardian -> npcs/tier_1_boss, Walker -> npcs/tier_2_boss, troopers -> npcs/trooper, 'Enemy Taking Mid Boss' -> minimap/super_neutral_marker. Base Guardians have no portrait of their own and share the Guardian one. Rules are regexes on the unit id, first match wins; a unit's own m_strCustomUnitIcon always wins over a rule.
